mapper.select: select device.code, device.name from telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config inner join device_satellite device on device.id = rule_config.device_satellite_id and device.task_id = rule_config.task_id and device.is_deleted = 0 where rule_config.task_id = #{taskId} and rule_config.id = #{ruleId} and rule_config.is_deleted = 0

select table_index, telemetry_code from telemetry_parse_rule_config where task_id = #{taskId} and is_deleted = 0 and exists (select 1 from device_satellite d where d.id = device_satellite_id and d.task_id = telemetry_parse_rule_config.task_id and d.is_deleted = 0) and case when table_index ~ '^[0-9]+$' then table_index::numeric end in
#{tableIndex}
